scope: No-model RTL3.0 replacement-owner and stop-for-review map. It changes no Chisel owner, top wiring, architecture authority, schedule, numeric observable contract, or physical realization.
inherited_frozen_rules: R3/M2 is the sole metadata-publication and pending-to-packed authority boundary.
R5 owns packed-page and descriptor facts; R2/R1 own typed delivery, request, response, FIFO, credit, and terminal behavior.
Hot, direct-pending, and S2 owners provide payload/sideband/identity/generation facts but do not compute attention partials merely by owning K/V storage.
R4 preserves observable binary32 packet behavior, canonical hot->pending->packed order, normalization guard, and numeric-fault disposition.

current_boundary.current_convenience: tests may manually drive init acknowledgement and accepted R1 responses

replacement.identity_source: accepted R1 transaction_identity and reset epoch
replacement.generation_source: only an explicitly associated logical page/sidecar model; never an inferred response default

environment_assumptions: accepted request eventually receives one legal terminal under fairness
dut_guarantees: R1/R2 never duplicate, lose, or misattribute a response
stale or mismatched response does not deposit
replacement_records.post_replacement_prohibition: direct manual response or S2 payload/sidecar mutation cannot stand in for an accepted functional-memory transaction

current_boundary.current_convenience: cross-owner packed-page request, slot, generation, and sidecar completion are supplied outside the production top

replacement.interface: future accepted packed-read association feeding existing R2/R1 typed delivery and owner-local S2 deposition
replacement.reason: No existing owner is authorized to join these facts without selecting a scheduler or manufacturing a new cross-owner association.

environment_assumptions: none may substitute for the unresolved association
dut_guarantees: only exact accepted identity/page/generation/slot association may open or fill S2
stale, mismatch, duplicate, and terminal-fault facts cannot make S2 READY
replacement_records.post_replacement_prohibition: verification packed-S2 service/work/sidecar ingress is disabled once an explicitly reviewed replacement owner exists

current_boundary.current_provider: structural verification packet ingress or inactive top tie-off
current_boundary.current_convenience: already-computed partial packet contents may be injected without a query/position-aware partial producer

replacement.interface: new replaceable functional boundary from source-owner payload/sideband facts to frozen source packet/R4 partial fields
replacement.reason: The frozen incremental subsystem has no authorized query/position-to-partial interface; assigning computation to a storage owner would expand scope.

environment_assumptions: partial provider receives only an accepted source instance and its explicit query/position association
dut_guarantees: source owners do not emit an attention partial by storage ownership alone
partial provider preserves source identity, generation, canonical order, and four-consumer association
replacement_records.post_replacement_prohibition: testbench structural offers/fragments cannot substitute for the partial provider after its interface is reviewed
forbidden: hidden attention MAC in a storage owner

current_boundary.current_convenience: identity-matching success or fault is stimulated without a merge calculation

replacement.interface: existing merge_req, partial header, value fragment, merge response, and numeric_fault boundary
replacement.identity_source: accepted R6 merge request and matching partial source instances
replacement.observable_contract: frozen binary32 packet, canonical hot->pending->packed order, normalization guard, and numeric-fault disposition

environment_assumptions: provider receives only valid accepted partial packets in the frozen order
dut_guarantees: one matching success XOR numeric-fault result
R4 never bypasses R6 terminal ownership
replacement_records.post_replacement_prohibition: R4 result stub cannot provide a success outcome after the functional merge provider is active

stop_for_review.required_resolution: Name one association owner and accepted-carrier field map joining R6 request identity, R5 page/generation, R3 publication, S2 slot/generation, and R2 delivery context without changing scheduling.
Name the common-front-end query association and position/RoPE sideband interface, or explicitly retain a replaceable external functional PE/reference provider.

disposition.next_required_action: review and resolve the two stop-for-review items before their respective behavioral closures

forbidden: timing throughput area energy or PPA claim
pruning admission scheduler or atomic-publication change
